PR Summary by Qodo

Add terminal kickoff and kit apply, harden monitoring, and document operations ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 📝 Documentation 🧪 Tests 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add terminal commands for the phone’s kickoff and kit-apply workflows when the phone is
>  unavailable.
>• Correct transcript discovery, killed-task reporting, and journal reminders; add playbook and
>  worktree warnings.
>• Record harness-probe limits and provide tested runbooks for stops, recovery, migration, and
>  installation.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD CLI["Terminal CLI"] --> API["Shared API"] --> DAEMON["Job daemon"] --> RUNNER["Job runner"] --> MONITOR["Task monitor"] API --> KIT["Kit checks"] --> SPOOL["Job spool"] DAEMON --> PLAYBOOK["Playbook engine"] --> KIT ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Unify phone and terminal kit intake
- ➕ One service could enforce identical validation, naming, placement, and held-job rules across both transports. - ➖ Phone attachment fetching and collision renaming differ from terminal-supplied zip files; unification would broaden this PR and risk changing phone behavior.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the shared kickoff and held-apply filing paths introduced here. The transport-specific kit intake is reasonable for this scope; consider consolidating it only if future changes require identical intake policy across phone and terminal.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
